content: I noticed that Palomar can automatically make a PR fixing a formatting issue in formalization.yaml - would it be ok to use that feature right away, or should I avoid it until Palomar is announced publicly?

Specifically, this is in the context of #Project announcements > Prime gaps ≤ 246 / Axiom's PrimeGapsLib : we need to edit our formalization.yaml so that the relationship to the source is "formalizes" (because I didn't realise there was a strict list of permitted values). We will then add a note explaining the conditionality of the result.
